x: (Photo by Ed.Lacey)--Geoff North and Beevor(Herc/Wim) lead an impressive bunch early in the National Championships at Sutton Coldfield. Following up are Cox, Adcocks, Turner, Moxom, Ashton, D.
After a long spell of injury Geoff was back to fitness, but with only one race behind him before this he did all that could have been hoped for and gave way only to Beevor of Hercules Wimbledon.
It was particularly interesting to see how the North brothers and O'Hara held Hercules-Wimbledon's top trio of the Holt twins and Beevor to that two-second margin.

Still, contrary to pre-race opinion, Belgrave were having a good day and although Maurice Benn (Cambridge H) also passed our Gerry, Beevor (Hercules Wimbledon) and Newble (Medway) couldn't do likewise.

Runners finishing after him read like a list of who's who in English cross country: 18.A.Holden; 19.P.Standing; 22.R.Wilde; 23.D.Bedford; 27.K.Steer.....Crabb, Cannon, Beevor, Tagg....What a great pity that we did not turn out our best side to back him up and give ourselves a more respectable team place.
